content: If the configuration contains TcpIpDhcpAddressAssignments that refer to specific ports of an Ethernet Switch, DHCP server shall identify the port the request was received from , by calling EthIf_GetPortMacAddr() with the M AC address of the DHCP client and choose an available IP address of the TcpIpDhcpAddressAssignment related to the same port.
